input.body:
John,

Before I came to you saying 8D was ready, I went back through the whole turn against our actual records — Airtable, Linear, email, QuickBooks, and the QC/final-walk reports — instead of going off what got said in passing. Here's the straight story.

What's genuinely done and confirmed:
- In-house repairs: hallway drywall patches, kitchen faucet replacement, bedroom/living-room paint touch-ups.
- Carpet cleaning + seam fix — Victor Rios / A Plus (~5/23).
- Deep clean — Isela (~5/24).
- QC punch list from Jaime's 5/26 walk (hallway baseboard scuff + missing bedroom outlet cover) — you closed both 5/27.
- Unit cleared for showings 5/29.

So the make-ready turn itself is done and QC-passed. The catch is two appliance items that came up AFTER that May clearance and never got closed out:

1. Garbage disposal jam (Linear OPS-227) — reported 6/22, I hit it on the 6/22 Las Palmas ticket run. It's still sitting In Review and just needs a quick operation re-verify to close. I'll knock that out.

2. Refrigerator swap — this is the real one. It was scheduled for the morning of Thu 6/25 through Lone Star Maintenance Supply (it was the critical path that week for the lease signing, which is why the Rio Bend 214 dishwasher run got bumped to the afternoon). I can't find any confirmation anywhere — no completion in Airtable, no Linear issue, no vendor bill in QuickBooks, nothing in email or Slack — that the fridge actually got delivered and installed. It also wasn't being tracked by any ticket. I've logged a maintenance ticket for it (MT-2026-1327) and drafted a confirmation request to Diane at Lone Star, going out today.

One heads-up on the paperwork: there are QC/final-walk "PASS" reports floating around for 8D, but they don't mention either appliance item, so I'm not treating them as the final word until the fridge is confirmed. I've set the 8D make-ready record back to In Progress to match reality — it was reading "closed out / available immediately," which is stale.

What it'll take to finish:
- Confirm the 6/25 fridge swap was actually completed and the unit's operational (waiting on Lone Star — I'll chase it).
- Verify the garbage disposal on-site and close OPS-227.

Once those two are buttoned up I'll flip 8D to Ready and let you know it's genuinely good to go. I'd rather catch this now than call it ready and have the fridge or disposal bounce back on us a week later.

— James

**Don't tell John it's done yet.** The make-ready *turn* is genuinely finished and QC-passed, but two appliance items surfaced in late June — **after** the May "cleared" call — and neither is closed. One of them (the fridge) has no confirmation it ever happened, and it wasn't even being tracked. That's exactly the thing that would've bounced back on you.

## What I verified against the actual systems (not passing mentions)
Confirmed **done** — corroborated across Slack, email, and the QC reports:
- In-house repairs: hallway drywall, kitchen faucet replacement, bedroom/living-room paint (you + James, mid-May)
- Carpet clean + seam fix — Victor Rios / A Plus (~5/23)
- Deep clean — Isela (~5/24)
- QC punch list from Jaime's 5/26 walk (baseboard scuff + missing bedroom outlet cover) — John closed both 5/27; cleared for showings 5/29

Still **open** (post-clearance, never closed out):
1. **Garbage disposal jam — Linear OPS-227.** Reported 6/22, reset on your 6/22 Las Palmas ticket run, but still "In Review." Needs a quick on-site re-verify to close.
2. **Refrigerator swap — scheduled Thu 6/25 AM via Lone Star Maintenance Supply.** It was the critical path that week (the Rio Bend 214 dishwasher got bumped to the afternoon for it). **No completion record anywhere** — not Airtable, Linear, QuickBooks, email, or Slack — and it had no ticket at all. This is the real hanging thread.

⚠️ Note: the four July "PASS" final-walk/QC PDFs in the shared drive don't mention either appliance item (and conflict with each other), so I did not treat them as the final word.

## What I did to get it moving & square up the records
- **Drafted a confirmation request to Diane at Lone Star** (cc John, Randy, Patricia) asking whether the 6/25 fridge swap was completed/operational — it's in your Gmail drafts, ready to send.
- **Logged the fridge swap as a maintenance ticket (MT-2026-1327, High)** in Airtable to close the tracking gap.
- **Commented on OPS-227** to advance it (reset done 6/22, pending final verify).
- **Reconciled the Airtable make-ready record** back to **In Progress** with accurate notes (it was reading "closed out / available immediately"), and updated the duplicate 8D record to point to it.
- **Posted the true status to #make-ready** so the crew stops working off the old note.
- **Drafted John's email** ("Las Palmas 8D — where it really stands…") in your Gmail drafts, laying out done/open/what's-left in your voice.

## To genuinely close 8D
1. Get Lone Star's confirmation the fridge was installed and works.
2. Re-verify the disposal on-site and close OPS-227.

Send the two drafts (John + Lone Star) and once both items land, flip the make-ready record to Ready — then it's a clean "done" to John.
